description: AutoHotkey v2 script: knob press controls media on the EPOMAKER x AULA F75
readmeMarkdown:
# AULA Volume Knob

An [AutoHotkey](https://www.autohotkey.com/) v2 script that makes the volume knob on the EPOMAKER x AULA F75 control your music, not just mute.

By default, pressing the knob mutes your sound. This script changes that:

| Knob press | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| Press once | Play / pause |
| Press twice | Next track |
| Press three times | Previous track |
| Shift + press | Mute |

Turning the knob still changes the volume as normal.

## Setup

1. Install [AutoHotkey v2](https://www.autohotkey.com/).
2. Download [`AULA-Volume-Knob.ahk`](AULA-Volume-Knob.ahk).
3. Double-click it. A green "H" icon appears in your system tray, and the knob now works the new way.

To run it every time you start Windows, press `Win + R`, type `shell:startup`, and put a shortcut to the script in that folder.

## Tweaking

After a press, the script waits 350 milliseconds to see if you press again. A single press therefore reacts after a short pause. To change the wait, edit the `350` in this line:

```ahk
SetTimer(HandleKnobPresses, -350)
```

A bigger number gives you more time to double or triple press. A smaller number makes a single press feel quicker.

## Other keyboards

The script only watches for the "mute" key, which is what the AULA F75 knob sends when pressed. It should work with any keyboard whose knob press sends mute.
